v0.1.0-alpha.1:
• First alpha release of the Collectarr metadata backend — the hosted metadata-only central backend for the Collectarr platform.
• Broad provider coverage for comics, manga, books, TV/anime, and barcode/UPC lookup flows including ComicVine, GCD, Hardcover, MangaDex, TMDB, and AniList.
• Admin metadata tooling for ingest previews, moderation queues, provider status, and user/image-cache administration.
• Canonical metadata APIs with creators, story arcs, characters, series relations, and typed provider candidates.
• Public read-only metadata endpoints for app catalog browsing without auth.

### ✨ Features

• Bootstrapped the Collectarr metadata platform with a metadata-only central backend architecture.
• Added broad provider support: ComicVine, GCD, Hardcover, MangaDex, TMDB, AniList, barcode/UPC lookup.
• Admin tooling: ingest previews, moderation queues, polling detail, provider status visibility, user/image-cache administration.
• Canonical metadata APIs: creators, story arcs, characters, series relations, richer item detail endpoints, typed provider candidates.
• Search indexing, provider preview caching, cover mirroring, thumbnail generation, and bounded image-cache pipeline.
• Self-hosted sync support and catalog badge/reporting automation.
• Cached and surfaced provider metadata lookups.
• Added batch hydrate endpoint for TMDB import flow.
• Made read-only metadata endpoints public (no auth required for catalog browsing).
• Added interactive database schema explorer and documentation.

### 🐛 Fixes

• Hardened auth, image access, provider ingest/search flows, sync queue behavior, and local connection recovery.
• Fixed search fallbacks, stale metadata sessions/imports, malformed bcrypt handling, and Meilisearch admin stats.
• Corrected comics/manga routing defaults, volume lookup behavior, variant cover mapping, and thumbnail migrations.
• Secured image asset uploads and improved mirrored-cover validation.
• Reduced noisy backend logging and trimmed sync changelog payloads.
• Folded the initial database schema into a single baseline migration; fixed CORS and stats edge cases.
• Improved performance for blocking operations, image routes, batch downloads, and local stack writes.

### 🧰 CI & Build

• Added container release publishing for `ghcr.io/collectarr/collectarr-core`.
• Standardized semantic-release around categorized release notes and changelog generation.
• Split release validation into a dedicated workflow.

### 🧪 Tests

• Updated TMDB assertions and ingest coverage around lazy-loading regressions.
v0.1.0-alpha.2:
• A focused backend hardening release between `v0.1.0-alpha.1` and `v0.1.0-alpha.2`, centered on seed tooling, richer episode imagery, and tighter provider-search access control.
• The release improves local/dev data seeding, extends TMDb episode payloads, and closes off anonymous provider search.
• It also bundles the branch cleanup needed to keep the alpha line healthy before the larger integration drop.
v0.1.0-alpha.3:
• This release lands the pending `collectarr-core` integration PR onto `main` and rolls together the validated admin-domain split, metadata/schema work, image-pipeline fixes, and release/deployment cleanup.
• It brings the previously validated branch set into one linear history while preserving migration, search, seed, and image-processing improvements.
• The resulting backend baseline is cleaner to ship, easier to operate, and fully validated against the integrated test suite.
v0.1.0-alpha.4:
• TMDb collections are now supported as a first-class item kind, with full provider lookup, normalization, and catalog routing.
• Kind canonicalization removes `manga` and `anime` from the `ItemKind` enum — manga items are now `comic`, anime items are now `movie` (or `tv` where appropriate). Provider-level provenance (`anime:`, `manga:` prefixes) is preserved in `provider_item_id` for lossless round-tripping.
• Title extensions let the metadata endpoint expand a single item into related titles (e.g. `movie → collection → other movies in that collection`).
• All library seed scripts are fully enriched with realistic metadata payloads across every supported kind.

### ✨ Features

**TMDb Collections & Title Extensions (#17)**

• Added `ItemKind.collection` with `MediaTypeConfig`, TMDb provider routing, and catalog registration.
• Title-extension endpoint expands items through their TMDb collection membership.
• `public_item_kind()` now canonicalizes incoming `manga`→`comic` and `anime`→`movie` at the schema boundary.

**Kind Canonicalization (#17)**

• Removed `manga` and `anime` from `ItemKind` enum; all providers updated to return canonical kinds.
• AniList, ComicVine, Hardcover, MangaDex, and TMDb providers preserve raw provenance via prefixed `provider_item_id` values.
• TMDb provider routes `anime:` prefixed IDs to TV-style fields (`name`, `episode_run_time`, `first_air_date`).

**Enriched Seed Scripts (#17)**

• `seed_all_libraries.py` rewritten with full metadata payloads (titles, creators, dates, ratings, dimensions) for all 10 item kinds.
• Removed stale manga/anime seed paths from `seed_full.py`.

### 🧪 Validation

• All tests pass after canonicalization — 14 production files and 11 test files updated in lockstep.
• New `collection` MediaTypeConfig verified by `test_media_catalog_covers_all_item_kinds`.
• Anime normalization test validates TV-style field routing for `raw_media_type="anime"`.
